A simple, free PDF viewer with a few tricks: select, copy, highlight, and edit paragraphs. Changes are saved straight into the PDF.

Built with PdfBox-Android (Apache License 2.0). Edited text is written with Liberation Fonts (SIL Open Font License 1.1) and DejaVu Fonts.
